en: Black-and-white image of a large Baroque water castle reflected in a calm lake. The building has four prominent round corner towers with onion-shaped domes and lanterns, a central section with a tall spire, arched windows, and a landscaped terrace with trees and small outbuildings along the water's edge. The photograph is vertically oriented, emphasizing the reflection of the castle in the water. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
